title: The Northwest Hospitality Leadership Podcast
author: Washington Hospitality Association
description: The hospitality workforce is changing rapidly, which means the industry is looking for its next generation of leaders. This podcast series is dedicated to teaching people how to lead a team. From the Washington Hospitality Association, ORLA, with Chris Jenson of the Table Group.
